faq.a: Some quality loss is inevitable with lossy compression (JPG/WebP). Our tool lets you control the trade-off with the quality slider. PNG uses lossless compression, so quality is preserved.
Input: JPG, PNG, WebP. Output: JPG or PNG (PNG preserves transparency).

faq.q: Is there a file size limit?
faq.a: There is no hard limit, but very large images (>20MB) may cause performance issues depending on your device's memory.
Currently one image at a time. Batch compression is planned for a future update.
